summary: Turn strategic evidence into decisions, KPI scorecards and executive briefs. Explore the five-day foundation course and review the outline.
lede: Leadership training covering McKinsey 7S helps team leads, strategy analysts and department heads assess evidence and turn it into decision-ready priorities. This foundation course develops PESTLE scanning, evidence-based SWOT analysis and 7S alignment diagnosis, then applies KPI interpretation and stakeholder mapping to produce concise executive briefs.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who turn strategic evidence into leadership choices, team priorities or executive updates. It is designed for foundation-level learners who need a structured way to examine signals and communicate their implications.
prerequisites: No formal strategy qualification is required. Basic experience contributing to team decisions, planning or performance reporting is helpful. No coding or specialist software is required.
